programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Killen Som Älskar Grupparbete
programme.desc: Phoebe går med i den coola gruppen i ett skolarbete, men upptäcker att de inte vill jobba lika hårt som hon. Max tar Phoebes vanliga plats i hennes vänners grupp för att försöka åka snålskjuts medan de andra gör allt arbete.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Superbarnvakterna
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max verkar vara två vanliga tonårstvillingar, men de tillhör en familj superhjältar. Phoebe strävar efter att vara normal och använder sina krafter för att göra gott, men Max väljer den mörka sidan. Kan livet bli normalt för familjen?

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Middagsbjudning
programme.desc: Max planerar att sabotera middagen när Phoebe bjuder hem killen hon är kär i och hans familj för att imponera på dem, men när en oväntad gäst dyker upp måste Phoebe och Max samarbeta för att förhindra att kvällen förvandlas till en katastrof.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Betyg
programme.desc: Efter att ha ändrat sina betyg och flyttats upp till avancerad matte, får Max tävla mot Phoebe i 'Matteduellen'. Samtidigt försöker Hank, Nora och Billy att fånga den gäckande tidningstjuven.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe mot Max
programme.desc: När Max utsätter Phoebe för ett practical joke när de ska ta skolfoton utbryter ett practical joke-krig mellan dem som går överstyr. Samtidigt försöker sig Hank och Barb på en ny uppfostringsmodell för att få Billy och Nora att hjälpa till hemma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Knäpp Teknikmässa
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max låter sin gamla rivalitet blossa upp när de hjälper Billy och Nora med deras projekt för skolan teknikmässa. Under tiden försöker Barb ta Hank på bar gärning efter att han har kopierat hennes anteckningar för bokklubben.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Helggästen
programme.desc: Phoebe har anmält sig som frivillig för att ta hand om klassens Flugfälla över helgen, men när Max utför experiment på den, börjar den växa och hotar till slut att ta över hela huset.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Skolkdagen
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe använder sina krafter för att roa sig under Skolkdagen, men när de kommer på att det finns övervakningskameror på skolan tar de hjälp av Billy och Nora för att radera filmerna innan hemligheten avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe är en Klon Nu
programme.desc: Efter att Phoebe tagit på sig alldeles för många aktiviteter, hjälper Max till genom att skapa en klon så att hon kan vara på två ställen samtidigt. När klonen börjar ställa till det för den riktiga Phoebe måste Max hjälpa till att rädda henes rykte.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Det här ser ut att vara ett job för
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe tar jobb på en pizzarestaurang för att få råd att köpa den nya mePhonen, och var för sig försöker de imponera på chefen med egna idéer. När Max tar på sig en för stor beställning måste de samarbeta för att rädda sina jobb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Bli Knasig
programme.desc: En komet gör att Thundermans krafter blir knasiga samtidigt som killen Phoebe är kär i bjuder henne på skoldansen. Phoebe och Max får veta att om de håller ihop kan de hålla sina krafter i styr, men ingen är speciellt glad för att ha den andra nära.

programme.title: South Park: Hummelfigurer & Heroin
programme.desc: Flera älskade underhållare går ur tiden efter att ha överdoserat på opiater, och Stan är på vippen att avslöjas som källan till dessa olagliga droger.

programme.title: South Park: Jul i Kanada
programme.desc: Kyles adopterade bror Ike hämtas tillbaka till Kanada av hans biologiska föräldrar eftersom den nya kanadensiska premiärministern har bestämt att alla barn som adopterats från Kanada måste lämnas tillbaka.

programme.title: South Park: Klubbhus
programme.desc: Pojkarna bestämmer sig för att bygga ett klubbhus så att de kan leka sanning eller konsekvens med Wendy och hennes kompis Bebe.

programme.title: South Park: Bajsproblem
programme.desc: Mr Hankeys stötande beteende gör att han riskerar att få sparken som chef för julspektaklet. På grundskolan möter Stark Kvinna och PK-rektorn nya utmaningar i sin relation.

programme.title: South Park: Häxsöner
programme.desc: På den årliga Halloweenfesten läser en häxa en trollformel som förpestar livet för alla i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Innerstaden
programme.desc: South Parks stadskärna håller på att gentrifieras och Kenny beslutar sig för att det är dags att skaffa jobb.

programme.title: South Park: Allt om mormonerna?
programme.desc: En ny kille, Gary, anländer till South Park och hans familj är mormoner. Eric blir vän med honom men blir besviken på den mormonska berättelsen.

programme.title: South Park: Gothbarn 3: poserarnas gryning

programme.title: South Park: Sarkasmboll
programme.desc: Randy fäller en sarkastisk kommentar om att football är för farligt för barn - men den ger upphov till skapandet av en ny, ofarlig sport som inbegriper behåar och en ballong.

programme.title: South Park: Ruttna tomater

programme.desc: While vacationing in California, Earl Morris learns that his wife has gone missing from their Arizona home. The search for Ruby Morris involves dozens of investigators and scientists — and even the Coast Guard.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Charred Remains
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak, a fire is started in a dumpster in Vancouver. No one sees the arsonist or the fire, which burns for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there's more than garbage in this flaming container.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Postal Mortem
programme.desc: On October 15, 1985, two bomb explosions rocked Salt Lake City and resulted in two deaths. A third explosion occurred the next day; this time, the victim survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Micro-Clues
programme.desc: After a day of fishing in a quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy doesn't return home as planned. The investigation reveals some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Common Thread
programme.desc: After 10 bodies turn up in Florida, one victim — 17-year-old Lisa McVey — is abducted but released. She leads police to the perpertrator, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: Flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children prove to be something more serious: thallium poisoning. After the mother's death, investigators turn their attention to finding the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: On the Case: At Death's Door
programme.desc: After a single mother is viciously attacked and left for dead, she still manages to help police track down her assailant.

programme.title: On the Case: Hidden by Fire
programme.desc: When firefighters respond to a raging house fire they discover the blaze was just the cover up for a vicious murder.

programme.title: On the Case: A Hole in their Hearts
programme.desc: A mother of three disappears from her office in broad daylight, and the case remains open for eight years until two farmers unearth a clue.

programme.title: On the Case: Under Suspicion
programme.desc: When a 26 year old wife and mother vanishes, investigators wonder if she simply just ran away or if it was something far more sinister. The search for answers would take nearly a decade and lead her family on a dark journey they could never have imagined.

programme.title: On the Case: No Exit
programme.desc: A young couple, out on the town in Washington D.C., is gunned down in a savage attack. Investigators are at a loss. Would it take another murder to solve the mystery?

programme.title: On the Case: Path of Destruction
programme.desc: When a 14 year old girl is murdered detectives must solve several terrifying crimes before they can bring her killer to justice.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Key to the Enigma (Farid Ouzzane Case)
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man. In order to identify this unknown man, whose face was unrecognizable.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Nelly Crémel Case
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Murder in Le Grand Bornand (Flactif case)
programme.desc: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear. For several days, mystery reigns.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Ordeal of Schoolgirl (Perrais case)
programme.desc: Laetitia Perrais, 18, a trainee hotel waitress, vanishes after evening service.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Disappearences in Paris - Christelle Leroy
programme.desc: On March 21th 1991, Pascale Escarfail, 19 years old, is discovered dead at her studio in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, she was raped then stabbed multiple times.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Crossover
programme.desc: A mishap in the wormhole sends Kira and Bashir into an alternate universe where Bajor is a tyrannical power and humans are slaves.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Worf och Data ger sig ut på ovanliga resor för att leta reda på sina fäder.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Fängslad i ett samhälle med fredliga klingoner och romulaner riskerar Worf sitt liv för att visa de yngre klingonerna deras förlorade arv och inspirera dem till att kräva sin heder.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: När borgerna återvänder för att slåss mot Federationen stoltserar de med en ny personlighet och frestar Data när de hjälper honom att känna sin första känsla.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Data håller Picard, Troi och Geordi som fångar. Data har lämnat Enterprise och slagit sig samman med sin onda bror Lore som ledare för borgerna.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Datas första hemska dröm blir en verklig mardröm för resten av Enterprises besättning.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Delivery
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, a serial bomber targets a judge, two attorneys and even a courthouse.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Similar Circumstances
programme.desc: Robert Sims returns home after working the night shift and finds his wife unconscious on the kitchen floor. Their son is fast asleep in an upstairs bedroom, but their six-week-old daughter, Heather, is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crime Seen
programme.desc: Edward Honaker was convicted of rape, sodomy and aggravated sexual battery and sentenced to three life terms in prison. He maintained his innocence. After years in prison and writing countless letters, he finally found someone who believed him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Speck of Evidence
programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: On a cold December night in 1993, Rose Larner stopped in a convenience store on her way to her boyfriend's house. She was never seen or heard from again. Rose's disappearance remained a mystery, until a tiny clue is found years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Killing Room
programme.desc: When Scott Dunn goes missing, police spray his bedroom with Luminol and uncover a scene of horrific violence. Now investigators face a daunting task: proving that Scott Dunn had been murdered without a body, a witness or a murder weapon.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Talking Skull
programme.desc: In 1987, a human skull and some bones were discovered at a Boy Scout Camp near Farmington, Missouri. Facial reconstruction aids the investigators in this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Beaten by a Hair
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Forensic scientists use evidence from her bedroom to direct police to a prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Trace
programme.desc: After being admitted to the hospital with unexplained bleeding, 11-month-old Chad Shelton dies. Investigators and scientists frantically search for a cause when others from the same house fall ill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Knot for Everyone
programme.desc: The bodies of several women are found on a remote hill in California. The police get a break when a prostitute escapes and is able to identify her attacker and his automobile.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Adeline Piet Case
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! What has happened to Adeline Piet?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Hanging On Houseboat (Aubry case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
programme.desc: On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed.
